entries.en: It's a cabinet for kitchen[n]supplies. I wonder if there's[n]a suitable pot in here...
I found an old earthenware[n]vessel. It should be big enough.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's almost time for the others to get back[n]from their shopping trip, so I'll leave[n]you be.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'll be down here for a while though...[n]Just be careful with the fire, okay?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: There's nothing but coffee stuff in there.[n]Try looking somewhere else.
